info.description: REST API for TeslaMate data, including V1 resources and V2 objective analytics.
info.title: TeslaMateApi

get.description: Returns cars registered in TeslaMate. Omit CarID to list all cars; include CarID for a single car.
get.summary: List TeslaMate cars or get one car

get.description: GET returns enabled_commands. POST proxies to Tesla Owner API; response body follows Tesla API JSON. Also registered as POST /v1/cars/{CarID}/wake_up.
get.summary: Tesla vehicle commands (when ENABLE_COMMANDS is true)

post.description: GET returns enabled_commands. POST proxies to Tesla Owner API; response body follows Tesla API JSON. Also registered as POST /v1/cars/{CarID}/wake_up.
post.summary: Tesla vehicle commands (when ENABLE_COMMANDS is true)

get.description: Returns the V2 analytics API version, the per-domain feature flags (compare/timeseries/breakdown), and the allowed breakdown values per do Clients use this to decide which query parameters to send instead of probing each endpoint.
Returns objective latest battery range samples, estimated full-range values, baseline range, and estimated range degradation. These estimates are not official state of health.
Returns estimated full rated and ideal range grouped by day, week, month, or year for trend charts.
Returns objective charging statistics for one car.
Returns objective charging-cost analytics. Current data scope includes charging_cost only and excludes insurance, maintenance, parking, depreciation, tire, and repair costs.
Returns objective driving statistics for one car.
Returns driving metrics grouped by day, week, month, or year for charting.
Returns objective parked duration, state duration, inferred parking sessions, and estimated parking drain for one car.
Returns objective driving, charging, parking, battery, update, and charging-cost summary metrics for one car in a selected period.
Returns cumulative lifetime statistics for a car from the first recorded event up to as_of (defaults to now). Use as_of for historical snapshots.

parameters.description: Cutoff datetime in RFC3339 format. Defaults to now.
parameters.name: as_of

get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated unified chronological timeline of drive, charging, and update events.

parameters.description: Return events before this RFC3339 timestamp (cursor, DESC order)
parameters.name: before

parameters.description: Return events after this RFC3339 timestamp (cursor, ASC order)
parameters.name: after

get.description: Returns OTA update history statistics for a car in the selected period.

comparison.description: Comparison keys: driving/charging/parking/battery/updates/vehicle/cost field paths; values are current vs previous period.
